overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SPCX ETF (SPCQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x inverse leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A (NASDAQ: SPCX), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as options and swap agreements. SPCQ was launched on Jun 14, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
